statement: We made a first step in analyzing the generalized reordering buffer management problem in an online setting, and provided non-trivial upper bounds on the competitive ratio. An obvious direction for future research is the design of new algorithms with further improved bounds. By now, both the paging problem and the reordering buffer problem are very well understood. It seems natural to utilize the known techniques and state of the art algorithms for these problems in order to obtain better results for generalized reordering buffer. Nevertheless, it turns out to be a challenging task to establish bounds on such combinations. We do not know whether natural combinations of such algorithms can attain good performance guarantees,
